Docs.summary: Provides a task-based connection method for tag technologies.

remarks.para: The managed wrapper is generated by Java.Interop's pinned extension-method generator. It schedules the synchronous call with Task.Run; it does not add native asynchronous I/O or a cancellation token. The underlying connection requirements are defined by the Android 16 tag technology contract.

Docs.summary: Connects the specified technology to its tag on a thread-pool thread.
Docs.returns: A task that represents the call to .

remarks.para: This managed extension uses Task.Run to call . Await the task before starting tag I/O. Only one technology can be connected to a tag at a time. Call when I/O is complete.
The method has no cancellation-token parameter. Calling from another thread cancels a blocked connection call with ; this is not task cancellation through a token.
